description: QuietPoint conformance: where playback resumes so that it starts after a pause in the narration instead of inside a word. Input: the loudness of the audio around the wanted time as runs (level: linear RMS, seconds), the time the first run starts at, and the wanted time. A pause is at least 0.15 s below 3 % of the loudest frame. Of the pauses that end between 3 s before and 1 s after the wanted time, the one ending nearest to it wins; playback starts 0.1 s before its end (never before its start). No such pause: null, and the caller keeps the wanted time. Frames are 0.02 s. Run by both cores.

cases.name: a pause just after the wanted time (the dash in a long sentence): skip the word fragment
a pause just before the wanted time
two pauses: the nearer end wins, also when it lies after the wanted time
two pauses: the earlier one is nearer
a gap shorter than 0.15 s is a consonant, not a pause
a pause that ends more than 1 s after the wanted time is too far ahead
silence that never ends inside the window has no end to start from
quiet is relative: room tone under loud speech counts as a pause
a short pause: start at its beginning, not before it
